title: I drew a map months ago….
content: I can’t believe that this is real. Everything you guys said. The wetlands, coastal region. Train station. Amusement parks. University (mine is by mountains and forest?). It’s an old attempt and I couldn’t remember everything but these are places I’ve been to. This was drawn around October. I don’t seem to have the dreams anymore. But they were vivid, and was like an escape. I could drink, do drugs, fall in love. It was insane. The mall was massive and seemed to never end. I remember walking through the city and driving around. Lots of curvy highways and roads. Weird names I know for some things but idk how else to describe them. “Asian playing fields” “safari Savannah” and “Europa” were places I’d have to take trains to. Europa was the most vivid. Just European towns and stores.
